title: Construction: 16-ADD physical anchor for a fixed five-subset block (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

On PR1230's fixed h9 six-by-six block, a dirty-output accumulator replaces its four-pass helper wrapper: **24 to 16 ADDs, 12 to 6 half-scaling scans, and complete Fourier-child rank mass 285 to 241** on the same thirteen raw array roles and final F boundary. All six output anchors pass; seed47 selects anchor5.

**Finite structural construction; no new kappa or supplier adoption.** This supplies exact Gaussian-dyadic physical phases, the inherited K/2 scale, source births, helper boundary, borrowed-source restoration, literal address adapters and forward-only inverse-child wrappers. Forward adapter copies decrease133836 to104836; normalized inverse copies190668 to148612. The complete child moment improves for p in[0,1], but remains noncontracting:241>13*9=117.

The caller must permit temporary unobserved source borrowing and frame descents. CHILD internals, common-label realization, compatible monotone/global caller, hosting, compiler/tape/precision and analytic transfer remain open. Adapter counts are an explicit primitive bill, not a runtime benchmark. The standard accumulator identity and global/16-gate optimality are not claimed as new results.

## Task and overlap

Research base: c5108f0f68d482e5712a8e26a5978d47762dfc16. Retained source PR1230: fd470c4ade3139bc8d805c77558b9d6b823a1690. OS assignment **seed47** is retained across the disk hold and authorized resumption; no reroll. Scope refined to one physical fixed-block comparison; the domain is exactly the comparator plus six anchors, with no extended synthesis.

[Local claim and completed result](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f557f64c19686db7d8a1cf3959f102091d148e46/research/five-subset-physical-anchor-seed47/CLAIM.json). No pinned sprint issue exists; the permitted local fallback is used. PR1230 supplied the scalar/geometry handoff and explicitly left physical phases/boundaries open. PR1557's different H3/T4 binary unit-XOR optimum is credited, not duplicated. PR1482 and PR1525 concern different mask/caller classes.

Final refresh: upstream adc34159e0d6dc3dd2af2bdba3f5ca7376ef957e, unchanged five consumed source blobs/selected certificate; guidance changes read. Newest20 PR bodies, Discussion board through1593 and pinned1163 were checked, followed immediately before submission by newest10 PR bodies through1600. No matching fixed-block physical-anchor scope found in this bounded coverage; no repository-wide novelty guarantee. Only the new fifteen-file package is added; selected and upstream files are unchanged.

## Validation

Python3.12.14, macOS arm64, standard library only:

~~~sh
python3.12 -I -O -B research/five-subset-physical-anchor-seed47/test_package.py
~~~

Expected: PASS_SEED47_PHYSICAL_PACKAGE programs=7 columns=6656 controls=10 relocation=1 no_new_kappa.

Full spatial-kernel and code-disjoint512-character Walsh replays pass both directions and all arbitrary dirty inputs. Exact component-row-l1 peak is128, with recursive-child hidden states excluded. Nine primary semantic controls, thirteen independent controls, ten actual file corruptions and offline spaced-path relocation pass. Missing evidence fails without regeneration. Default normal and optimized checks pass; all25 selected-result checks and the source-bound baseline/context guards pass. The staged and remote Git trees match exactly. Details in VALIDATION.md and exact pins/receipts in SOURCES/PROGRAMS/RESULT/INDEPENDENT.

Not run: full selected cold replay, Linux, Lean or human peer review. Finite evidence is not formal verification of the multiplication theorem; selected PR1094 remains unchanged.

## Credit and open next questions

Credit PR1230/1173, Douglas Colkitt's kernel, ArnavSwiggy/PR920, woklerx/PR1139, icekylinx's Clifford frames, concurrent Hanson Sun/PR1557 and the retained eumemic/DreamingOfClouds/Jacob Sussman lineage. Original predecessor notices and bytes are retained. Prepared for **@ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including one bounded independent Walsh/proof worker; this is not independent human review. Apache-2.0.

README.md proposes a fully observed two-query source cut as the smallest next step toward removing source gauge returns. A compatible caller and complete global invoice are the blockers; another scalar-only optimization does not establish contraction here.
